operatorAliases: Maintal-Werke Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung - Stadtwerke der Stadt Maintal -

stationScope.evidence: Maintal-Werke's official tariff page states 0.39 EUR/kWh AC/DC specifically at Maintal-Werke charging stations, separately from ladenetz.de and roaming tariffs. Current BNetzA-derived station data identifies DE*MWG on Maintal-Werke infrastructure, including the 300 kW Maintalbad site.

roamingDeferred.reason: The official page publishes different ladenetz.de, roaming and high-price-operator rates. Those are eMSP terms and must never be propagated to third-party physical CPOs.

note: Official tariff valid from 2025-01-01 and still published on 2026-09-04. License cost is 9.99 EUR per card/month. Blocking fee is 0.10 EUR/min after 240 minutes AC or 60 minutes DC, capped at 12 EUR.
